reason: The discovery and description of Spinosaurus mirabilis was published in Science and announced in February 2026, more than eight months prior to November 2026. Because the reports document an event from earlier in the year, this is old news rather than a current development.

story.headline: Scientists Discover New Dinosaur Species Deep in the Sahara Desert
story.summary: Paleontologists have uncovered a previously unknown dinosaur species deep within the Sahara Desert. The discovery offers new insights into prehistoric ecosystems and regional biodiversity.
